title: double-doors-lite
description: This is a lightweight mod which allows doors to open together when next to each other.
body:
![Double Doors Mod](https://i.imgur.com/QalHEv3.png)

# Double Doors Lite

**Open one door and the door beside it opens too — just like a real set of double doors.**

Place two doors side by side, open one, and its neighbour swings open with it (and closes with it). The two leaves automatically mirror, so they swing **apart** like a proper double door instead of both swinging the same way.

No items, no recipes, no config — drop it in and your doors just work the way you always wanted them to.

## Features

- **Automatic double doors** — open or close one door and the adjacent door follows, in the same tick, with no lag.
- **Mirrored swing** — a matched pair flips to opposite hinges so the two leaves open apart, the way double doors should.
- **Any orientation** — pairs adjacent doors whether they face the same way or opposite ways. As long as they're side by side, they're connected.
- **Wooden & copper doors** — every hand-openable door is supported. Iron doors are left entirely to redstone, untouched.
- **Single pair, no surprises** — only the door's direct left/right neighbour responds. No runaway chains down a row of doors.
- **Lightweight & server-side** — all the logic runs on the server, so it works in singleplayer and on multiplayer servers, with no performance overhead and nothing extra for the world to track.

## How it works

When you open or close a door by hand, Double Doors Lite looks at the doors immediately to its left and right and matches them to the one you just used — and nothing else. It never consumes your click or changes normal door behaviour; it just adds the second leaf. If a neighbour shares the clicked door's facing, its hinge is flipped so the pair opens symmetrically.

## Compatibility

- **Minecraft:** 26.2 *(also available for 26.1)*
- **Loaders:** Fabric and NeoForge
- Fabric builds require **Fabric API**.

---

*"Lite" by design — it does one thing, and does it cleanly.*
